name_ar: باحث القدرات ثنائي اللغة دون اتصال
what: يرتّب قدرات كتالوج KOSIF لمهمة مكتوبة بالعربية أو الإنجليزية بمطابقة موزونة للحقول مع ترجيح الكلمات النادرة في فهرس الأطلس المحلي، ويعيد المعرّفات والكلمات المطابقة والحالة المعلنة والمتطلبات مع تأكيد أنها غير مُتحقَّق منها تشغيليًا. — Ranks KOSIF catalog powers for an Arabic or English task using weighted field matching with corpus-rarity scoring over the local atlas index, and returns IDs, matched terms, claimed status and requirements with runtime_verified=false.
when: ابحث عن قدرات لتحريك شخصيات في فيديو / Find KOSIF powers for blender 3d geometry
how: rank: `python3 scripts/ai_tool_discovery.py "تحريك شخصيات فيديو" --top 8`; --doctor: `python3 scripts/ai_tool_discovery.py --doctor`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool ai-tool-discovery`. Limits: Lexical rarity-weighted ranking over the prebuilt atlas index; it neither checks that the index is fresh nor that requirements are met on this host, and it runs nothing.
params: in: A task phrase in Arabic or English. It reads data/capability_atlas_index.json. · out: JSON on stdout (schema kosif.original-discovery.v1).
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يطبع إحاطة ذاتية سريعة لـ Claude تشمل معلومات الجهاز، وأعداد القدرات في كل مجال، وعدد القدرات التي تتوفر كل متطلباتها المسجّلة، والتثبيتات التي تفتح أكبر عدد من القدرات. ويستطيع أيضًا إعادة توليد الملفين CAPABILITIES.md وllms.txt في جذر المستودع أو فحص تقادمهما. — Prints a short self-briefing for Claude: machine facts, catalog counts per domain, how many powers have every listed requirement present, and the installs that unlock the most powers. It can also regenerate or check the repo-root CAPABILITIES.md and llms.txt.
when: ابدأ الجلسة وقولي تقدر تعمل ايه هنا / Boot the KOSIF skill and brief yourself first
how: live: `python3 scripts/boot.py`; json: `python3 scripts/boot.py --json`; static-check: `python3 scripts/boot.py --static --check`; static-write: `python3 scripts/boot.py --static --write`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool boot`. Limits: 'Ready now' means only that every listed requirement was detected, and powers with no listed requirement (including documented, seen and idea records) also count, so it is not proof that any power works.
params: in: No input for the live briefing. Reads data/powers/*.json and data/requirements.json, and checks PATH, Python import specs, environment-variable names and font files to decide what is present. · out: Text or JSON on stdout. --static --write overwrites CAPABILITIES.md and llms.txt at the repo root. --static --check exits 1 when either file is stale.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يبحث في كتالوج KOSIF الذي يضم 4,751 قدرة بالعربية أو الإنجليزية، ويخطط للمهمة باختيار معرّفات القدرات ومهارات العمل والمسارات مع فحص المتطلبات محليًا، ويعيد بناء فهرس الأطلس ودليله. — Searches the 4,751-power KOSIF catalog in Arabic or English, plans a task by picking capability IDs, process skills, routes and local requirement checks, and rebuilds the atlas index and its guide.
when: ايه القدرات اللي تنفع لمهمة تايبوغرافي عربي متحرك؟ / Which KOSIF powers match 'Arabic kinetic typography'?
how: stats: `python3 scripts/capability_atlas.py stats --json`; doctor: `python3 scripts/capability_atlas.py doctor --json`; search: `python3 scripts/capability_atlas.py search "Arabic kinetic typography" --top 10 --domain motion --json`; plan: `python3 scripts/capability_atlas.py plan "Build a secure accounting app" --top 7 --json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool capability-atlas`. Limits: Ranks by keyword overlap with catalog text and checks requirements only by PATH or import-spec lookup; it never runs or verifies any capability.
params: in: A task phrase in Arabic or English, or a capability ID. It reads data/powers/*.json and data/capability_routes.json, plus data/capability_atlas_index.json when the index is fresh. · out: JSON on stdout for every command. build also writes data/capability_atlas_index.json and references/capability-atlas.md.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يطابق مهمة مكتوبة بالعربية أو الإنجليزية مع 22 مسارًا تنفيذيًا في KOSIF، ويعيد لكل مسار أمر التشغيل والأدوات الموجودة والناقصة والأذونات المطلوبة التي لم تُمنح بعد، مع حالة لا تدّعي أن شيئًا نُفّذ. — Matches an Arabic or English task to 22 executable KOSIF routes and returns, for each one, the runbook command, which binaries are present or missing, the permissions it needs that have not been granted, and a status that never claims execution.
when: حلل فيديو مرجعي وأنتج مونتاج مشابه بأصولي، أي سكربت أشغّل؟ / Which KOSIF script should I run to analyze song energy?
how: --task: `python3 scripts/capability_runtime_router.py --task "حلل فيديو مرجعي وأنتج مونتاج مشابه بأصولي" --limit 5 --json`; --id: `python3 scripts/capability_runtime_router.py --id reference-edit-remix --json`; --doctor: `python3 scripts/capability_runtime_router.py --doctor --json`; --list: `python3 scripts/capability_runtime_router.py --list --json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool capability-runtime-router`. Limits: Matches only against hand-written aliases for 22 routes and checks binaries on PATH; it never runs a runbook, never verifies permissions and never proves that a route works.
params: in: A task text or a route ID. It reads data/capability_routes.json (schema kosif.capability-routes.v1, at most 100 routes). · out: JSON on stdout. Each route gets one of four statuses: source_present_not_executed, missing_host_prerequisites, source_file_missing or external_not_integrated. Runbooks use a $SKILL_DIR placeholder. executed_in_current_request and verified_in_current_request are always false.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: سؤال واحد يعطي كل ما يلزم: الأدوات القابلة للتشغيل للمهمة بأمر جاهز ومعرفة هل يملك الجهاز مستلزماتها، والقدرات المناسبة من الكتالوج، والأدلة، والأساليب المرجعية لطلبات الموشن. — One question in, everything relevant out: the runnable tools for a task (with a copy-paste command and whether this machine has their requirements), the catalog powers, the guides and, for motion work, reference styles.
when: ابدأ أي مهمة: ايش الأداة اللي أشغّلها؟ / which KOSIF tool should I run for this task?
how: find: `python3 scripts/hub.py find "اعمل فيديو موشن عربي متزامن مع صوتي"`; tool: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool native-3d`; list: `python3 scripts/hub.py list --area 3d`; areas: `python3 scripts/hub.py areas`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool hub`. Limits: Ranks by keywords, registry metadata and catalog families; a high score means relevant, not proven to work for this exact request — open the tool card and run its doctor first.
params: in: a task in the user's words, a tool id, a power id or search words · out: ranked tools, powers, guides and styles as text or JSON; build writes manifest.json, references/INDEX.md and the hub blocks in SKILL.md and references/guides/*.md
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: خادم MCP للقراءة فقط عبر stdio يتيح لأي عميل MCP (Claude Code وClaude Desktop وCursor وغيرها) طرح أسئلة hub.py نفسها: البحث، بطاقات الأدوات، الجاهزية، القدرات وعائلاتها، والأدلة. — Read-only stdio MCP server that lets any MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor …) ask the same questions as hub.py: find, tool cards, doctor, power search and records, families and guides.
when: اربط Claude Desktop بكتالوج قدرات KOSIF / expose the KOSIF catalog to Cursor or another MCP client
how: serve: `python3 scripts/kosif_mcp.py`; selftest: `python3 scripts/kosif_mcp.py --selftest`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool kosif-mcp`. Limits: Answers questions only: it never runs a tool, installs, writes files or touches the network; for bounded file access use kosif-remote-commander.
params: in: MCP JSON-RPC requests on stdin · out: JSON-RPC responses on stdout; guide text is limited to files inside the skill folder
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: مدخل يعمل محليًا بلا شبكة وبلا استنساخ للمستودع. يفحص الأمر doctor المهارة المثبتة ويعرض عدد سجلات الكتالوج حسب الحالة ووجود أطلس الأساليب الكامل، ويحيل الأمر search البحث إلى كتالوج القدرات المحلي أو إلى أطلس الأساليب عند توفر نسخة كاملة من المستودع. — A no-network, no-clone entry point. `doctor` checks the installed skill and reports catalog record counts by status and whether the full style atlas is present; `search` forwards to the local power catalog or, inside a full kosif-tool checkout, to the style atlas.
when: شغّل المهارة من غير ما تعمل git clone / Auto mode blocked the clone, so use the installed skill instead
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/local_first.py doctor`; search-powers: `python3 scripts/local_first.py search neon glow --scope powers`; search-styles: `python3 scripts/local_first.py search sketch --scope styles`; skill-dir: `python3 scripts/local_first.py --skill-dir . doctor`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool local-first`. Limits: It never fetches, clones or installs anything, so in a standalone skill bundle the style atlas stays unavailable; doctor counts records and does not prove that any power runs.
params: in: Optional --skill-dir (default: this skill's folder), search words, and --scope auto|styles|powers. · out: doctor prints JSON on stdout. search prints the results of powers.py search or tools/kosif.py search and passes on its exit code. It exits 2 with a JSON error when --scope styles is requested but the atlas is absent, and exits 1 with a JSON error on stderr for an invalid skill dir.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يبيّن لكل توزيعة بايثون مذكورة (حتى 50 توزيعة) هل بياناتها الوصفية مثبتة وما إصدارها، دون استيرادها أو تثبيتها أو الاتصال بالشبكة. — Reports whether each named Python distribution (up to 50) has installed metadata and which version it is, without importing, installing or contacting the network.
when: هل pandas وnumpy متسطبين على الجهاز ده؟ / Check which of pandas, numpy and httpx are installed here
how: probe: `python3 scripts/python_package_probe.py pandas numpy httpx`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool python-package-probe`. Limits: Reads installed distribution metadata only and never imports the package, so a found package is not proven to import or work.
params: in: From 1 to 50 pip distribution names, such as pillow or opencv-python-headless. Import names such as PIL or cv2 do not work. · out: JSON on stdout with the Python version, one record per package and the scope current_environment_only_no_install_no_network.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يربط المهمة بمجموعة مرتبة من مهارات العمل الخمس عشرة المضمّنة من obra/superpowers الإصدار 7 (مثل العصف الذهني وتتبّع الأخطاء والتطوير المقاد بالاختبارات والتحقق)، ويفحص المصادر المضمّنة، ويستطيع تثبيت KOSIF مع تلك المهارات في ‎~/.claude/skills مع نسخ احتياطية. — Maps a task to an ordered set of the 15 vendored obra/superpowers v7 process skills (brainstorming, debugging, TDD, verification and others), checks the vendored sources, and can install KOSIF plus those skills into ~/.claude/skills with backups.
when: أي مهارات عمل أستخدمها لإصلاح عطل في التطبيق؟ / Which process skills apply to 'Fix the crash in the montage app'?
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/superpowers_unified.py doctor`; plan: `python3 scripts/superpowers_unified.py plan "Fix the crash in the montage app"`; list: `python3 scripts/superpowers_unified.py list`; install: `python3 scripts/superpowers_unified.py install --no-global-instructions`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool superpowers-unified`. Limits: plan is a fixed keyword-to-skill lookup and doctor checks only that files exist; neither one runs, verifies or tests any skill.
params: in: A task text for plan. It reads vendor/obra-superpowers-v7/skills/*/SKILL.md and LICENSE. install targets the user's home directory (~/.claude). · out: JSON on stdout. install also writes ~/.claude/skills/<name>/, ~/.claude/backups/kosif-ultimate-<stamp>/ and, optionally, ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يحسب تقديرًا تقريبيًا وحتميًا لسعة النظام (متوسط الطلبات في الثانية وذروتها، والحد الأدنى من النسخ، والتخزين المنطقي والمكرر بالبايت والجيبيبايت) من افتراضات المرور والعتاد التي يقدّمها المستخدم، بحساب عشري دقيق. — Computes a deterministic back-of-envelope capacity estimate (average and peak RPS, minimum replicas, logical and replicated storage in bytes and GiB) from caller-supplied traffic and hardware assumptions, using exact decimal arithmetic.
when: احسب لي كم سيرفر محتاج لو عندي مليون طلب في اليوم / estimate replicas and storage for 10M requests per day
how: size: `python3 scripts/architecture_sizer.py --daily-requests 86400 --peak-factor 5 --payload-bytes 1000 --retention-days 7 --replica-rps 100 --target-utilization 0.5 --copies 2`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool architecture-sizer`. Limits: Linear arithmetic on assumed numbers only; it runs no load test and excludes indexes, caching, backups, compression, burst shape, network, CDN, failover headroom and regional placement.
params: in: Six required numeric assumptions: --daily-requests, --peak-factor (>=1), --payload-bytes, --retention-days, --replica-rps and --target-utilization (0-1], plus optional --copies (a positive integer, default 1). · out: JSON on stdout (status deterministic_estimate_not_load_test, executed_benchmark false). It exits 2 with an argparse error on missing or out-of-range inputs.
section: Think, ideate and write / التفكير والأفكار والكتابة

what: يحوّل وصف مشكلة واحدة إلى قائمة JSON مرتّبة وقابلة لإعادة الإنتاج من أفكار هندسية قابلة للتفنيد (16 طريقة ابتكار × 4 زوايا)، لكل فكرة فرضية واختبار ومقياس نجاح وحدّ رفض. — Turns one problem statement into a reproducible, ranked JSON list of falsifiable engineering ideas (16 inventive methods × 4 lenses), each with a hypothesis, test, success metric and rejection threshold.
when: اقترح لي حلول مبتكرة لمشكلة بطء الترجمة على الموبايل / brainstorm falsifiable engineering alternatives for this bottleneck
how: methods: `python3 scripts/invention_lab.py methods`; invent: `python3 scripts/invention_lab.py invent "Make Arabic captions render faster on mobile" --count 12 --constraint "no paid APIs"`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool invention-lab`. Limits: Fills fixed templates from a problem string and ranks them by a SHA-256-seeded heuristic, so it gives no real novelty, feasibility, cost or patent assessment.
params: in: A problem statement of 8-2000 characters (positional), optional --count 1-64 (default 12) and repeatable --constraint strings. · out: JSON on stdout (schema kosif-invention-candidates-v1): problem, constraints, disclaimer and candidates with id, method, lens, proposal, hypothesis, test, success_metric, failure_threshold, novelty_status, risk, cost_class, priority_score.
section: Think, ideate and write / التفكير والأفكار والكتابة

what: يحوّل ملف JSON بصيغة kosif.audio-cues.v1 (بدايات الأصوات المقيسة والكلمات المحاذاة من audio_cue_mapper.py) إلى لوحة قصة قابلة للتحرير بصيغة motion_director، فيها نص مؤقّت ومسار يُرسم تدريجيًا وشخصية وتقريب كاميرا، مع تقرير قرار يقيّم أساليب doodle وkinetic وcinematic. — Turns a kosif.audio-cues.v1 JSON (measured onsets plus aligned words from audio_cue_mapper.py) into an editable motion_director storyboard with timed text, draw-on path, character and camera zoom, plus a decision report that scores the doodle, kinetic and cinematic styles.
when: حوّل التعليق الصوتي وتوقيت الكلمات لستوري بورد موشن جرافيك / turn my audio cues and word timings into an editable motion storyboard
how: plan (auto style): `python3 scripts/creative_reasoning_bridge.py ./cues.json --style auto --out ./out/scene.json --report ./out/decision.json`; plan (forced style, landscape): `python3 scripts/creative_reasoning_bridge.py ./cues.json --style kinetic --landscape --out ./out/scene.json --report ./out/decision.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool creative-reasoning-bridge`. Limits: Builds an unrendered storyboard from a hand-written style heuristic and amplitude onsets; it does not understand lyrics or emotion, verify beats, or render video.
params: in: A kosif.audio-cues.v1 JSON produced by scripts/audio_cue_mapper.py (duration 0.1-120 s, up to 600 onset candidates, up to 1,500 non-overlapping timed words), plus --out and --report paths that are new, distinct and inside existing directories. · out: Two new JSON files: the storyboard (motion_director spec version 1, ready for 'motion_director.py compile') and the report (schema kosif.creative-plan.v1: decision with style scores, evidence, validated_storyboard, render_status unrendered_storyboard). A summary is printed to stdout.
section: Motion graphics and rendering / الموشن والرندر

what: يتحقق من نص مشاهد بصيغة JSON مُوقَّت على مستوى الكلمات (مسارات ودوائر ونصوص وشخصيات وتحوّلات وحركة كاميرا) ثم يحوّله إلى رسم متحرك SVG/HTML مستقل قابل للتقديم إلى أي لحظة، مع إمكانية تصديره اختياريًا إلى MP4 عبر محرك العرض المرفق. — Validates a word-timed JSON scene script (paths, circles, text, characters, actors, morphs, camera) and compiles it into a self-contained seekable SVG/HTML animation, with an optional MP4 render through the bundled render_html.cjs.
when: اعمل لي موشن جرافيك عربي متزامن مع الكلمات من ملف JSON / Turn my words.json timings into an animated SVG explainer
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/motion_director.py doctor`; sample: `python3 scripts/motion_director.py sample --out ./scene.json`; compile: `python3 scripts/motion_director.py compile ./scene.json --out ./out/scene.html`; render: `python3 scripts/motion_director.py render ./out/scene.html --out ./out/scene.mp4 --audio ./voice.wav`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-director`. Limits: Compiles only its own validated vector primitives (≤80 elements, ≤120 s) and does not verify the rendered MP4, transcribe, or align audio itself.
params: in: Motion Director spec JSON v1: even width/height 320–4096, fps 24/25/30/60, duration ≤120 s, 1–30 continuous scenes with monotonic word timings, camera zoom/pan, ≤80 elements of type path|circle|text|character|actor|morph with hex colours; for render an existing HTML file and optional audio file. · out: JSON status on stdout; sample spec JSON; self-contained seekable HTML animation; optional MP4 (unverified) from render.
install: optional: bin:chromium, bin:ffmpeg, bin:ffprobe, bin:node, npm:playwright
section: Motion graphics and rendering / الموشن والرندر

what: سكربت يعمل في المتصفح يقرأ بيانات المشاهد بصيغة JSON من الوسم <script id=kosif-data> ويحرّك فيلم SVG بشكل حتمي: يرسم الخطوط كقلم حقيقي مع رأس قلم متحرك، ويُظهر النصوص تدريجيًا، ويحوّل المضلعات من شكل إلى آخر، ويحرّك شخصية خطية وممثلين بمفاصل محورية (مشي، جري، تلويح، إشارة، جلوس). كما يكبّر الكاميرا ويحرّكها لكل مشهد، ويعرض ترجمات عربية من اليمين إلى اليسار موقّتة بالكلمات، ويتيح الدالة window.__kosif.seek(t) لرندر دقيق إطارًا بإطار. — A browser-side script (IIFE) that reads scene JSON from <script id=kosif-data> and animates an SVG film deterministically: pen-style stroke draw-on with a moving pen tip, text fades, polygon morphs, a stick character, pivot-rigged actors (walk/run/wave/point/sit), per-scene camera zoom/pan and word-timed RTL captions. It exposes window.__kosif.seek(t) so frames can be rendered exactly.
when: ارسم لي مشهد سبورة بيضاء يتحرك بالقلم ومتزامن مع الكلام / Animate my SVG scene with draw-on strokes, a walking character and word-timed captions
how: embed: `python3 scripts/motion_director.py compile ./scene.json --out ./out/film.html`; seek: `window.__kosif.seek(2.5)  // in the compiled page: draws t=2.5 s, returns {time, scene, word}`; check: `node --check assets/motion_engine.js`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-engine-js`. Limits: Draws simple SVG strokes, polygon morphs and stick-figure rigs only, shows one caption word at a time, and needs a host page plus a separate renderer (render_html.cjs) to become MP4. It is not a general animation editor.
params: in: Scene JSON (validated by motion_director.py): {width, height, fps, duration, scenes:[{id, start, end, background, camera{fromZoom, toZoom, fromX, toX, fromY, toY, start, end}, words[{text, start, end}], elements[{type: path|circle|text|character|actor|morph, start, end, move{fromX, toX, fromY, toY, start, end}, ...}]}]}, embedded in a page that has SVG nodes #scene, #background, #stage, #art and #captions. · out: Live SVG DOM state for each seek(t), plus window.__kosif = {duration, fps, seek, source} and window.__kosifReady (a fonts-ready promise). It writes no files itself.
section: Motion graphics and rendering / الموشن والرندر

what: يحوّل ملف توقيت الكلمات بصيغة motion-starter-kit (lines[].words[]) إلى لوحة قصة أصلية لـ KOSIF Motion Director بعد التحقق منها، مع معاينة HTML اختيارية قابلة للتقديم، بأنماط plotter وdoodle وwhiteboard وinfographic. — Converts motalim-ai/motion-starter-kit word-timing JSON (lines[].words[]) into a validated native KOSIF Motion Director storyboard and optional seekable HTML for the plotter, doodle, whiteboard or infographic styles.
when: حوّل ملف توقيت الكلمات من motion starter kit لموشن وايت بورد / Build a doodle storyboard from my motion-starter-kit words.json
how: styles: `python3 scripts/motion_kit_bridge.py styles`; demo: `python3 scripts/motion_kit_bridge.py demo --style doodle --out ./out/demo-story.json --html ./out/demo-story.html`; build: `python3 scripts/motion_kit_bridge.py build --timings ./words.json --style plotter --out ./out/story.json --html ./out/story.html --fps 30`; build (estimated): `python3 scripts/motion_kit_bridge.py build --timings ./reading-estimates.json --allow-estimated --style whiteboard --out ./out/estimated-story.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-kit-bridge`. Limits: Executes only 4 of 10 upstream styles as native SVG approximations, does not render MP4, transcribe or align audio, and rejects KOSIF's flat words.json (top-level words[]).
params: in: Motion Starter Kit words.json: {duration, audio (filename or null), source, lines:[{words:[{w,start,end}]}]}; style plotter|doodle|whiteboard|infographic; fps 24/25/30/60; new output paths. · out: JSON status on stdout; Motion Director storyboard JSON (1080x1920) and optional self-contained seekable HTML; never an MP4.
section: Motion graphics and rendering / الموشن والرندر

what: ينشئ فيلم رسم يدوي على سبورة بيضاء بصيغة SVG قابلًا للتعديل (film.html وmotion.json) مع آلية تقديم حتمية، ويعرض 25 بطاقة توجيه لمحركات الحركة، ويصدّره عند التصريح بـ --run إلى صورة معاينة PNG أو فيديو MP4 بمقاس 1080x1920. — Scaffolds an editable Arabic whiteboard-doodle SVG film (film.html + motion.json) with a deterministic seek contract, lists 25 motion-engine route cards, and on explicit --run renders it to a 1080x1920 PNG preview or MP4 via render_html.cjs.
when: اعمل فيلم رسم يدوي عربي على سبورة بيضاء بالكود / Make me an editable whiteboard doodle film I can render to MP4
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/motion_runtime.py doctor`; engines: `python3 scripts/motion_runtime.py engines --family whiteboard`; scaffold: `python3 scripts/motion_runtime.py scaffold --out ./out/film --title "قصيف يرسم" --subtitle "الحركة تُولد بالكود" --duration 8 --fps 30`; render (dry): `python3 scripts/motion_runtime.py render --in ./out/film/film.html --out ./out/film/film.mp4`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-runtime`. Limits: The template is a fixed 8-second 1080x1920 whiteboard doodle performance (longer durations need hand-extended keyframes) and the render is not self-verified.
params: in: Scaffold: new output dir, title/subtitle 1–36 chars without newlines, duration 8–120 s, fps 24–60. Render: existing .html, new .mp4 or .png path, fps 24/30/60, optional audio file, --run to approve. · out: JSON status on stdout; project folder (film.html, motion.json, README.md); PNG preview or MP4 marked rendered_requires_visual_qa.
install: optional: bin:chromium, bin:ffmpeg, bin:ffprobe, bin:node, npm:playwright
section: Motion graphics and rendering / الموشن والرندر

what: يعرض 25 محركًا للحركة مسجّلة في الكتالوج، وينشئ مشاريع بداية أصلية غير مثبّتة لكل من GSAP وRemotion وManim وThree.js وPixiJS وp5.js تتيح التقديم إلى أي لحظة عبر window.__kosif. — Lists 25 catalogued motion engines and writes original, uninstalled starter projects for GSAP (+Rough.js/Vivus), Remotion, Manim, Three.js, PixiJS or p5.js that expose a seekable window.__kosif contract.
when: عايز مشروع بداية Three.js أو p5 للموشن / Scaffold a Remotion project for a 9:16 explainer
how: list: `python3 scripts/motion_stack.py list`; doctor: `python3 scripts/motion_stack.py doctor`; scaffold: `python3 scripts/motion_stack.py scaffold gsap --out ./out/kosif-gsap`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-stack`. Limits: Writes starter source only; it does not install packages, verify any engine runs, or render a video.
params: in: Backend name (gsap, remotion, manim, three, pixi, p5) and a new output directory whose parent exists; reads data/motion_sources.json. · out: JSON on stdout; a scaffold directory of original source files (package.json, index.html, src/main.js or Remotion src/*.jsx or Manim main.py) marked scaffold_created_not_installed.
install: optional: npm:@remotion/cli, npm:gsap, npm:p5, npm:pixi.js, npm:remotion, npm:roughjs, npm:three, npm:vite, npm:vivus, pip:manim
section: Motion graphics and rendering / الموشن والرندر

what: وحدة ES بلا اعتماديات تصدّر 12 دالة حركة حتمية يمكن الانتقال بها إلى أي لحظة زمنية: التقييد، ومنحنيات التسهيل، والاستيفاء بين الإطارات المفتاحية وخطوط الزمن، وكشف الخطوط في SVG، وتحريك الكاميرا وتكبيرها، وزوايا مفاصل دورة المشي، والمنظور المتوازي، واهتزاز الخط اليدوي ببذرة ثابتة، والرمز الزمني للإطارات، وحالة الترجمة على مستوى الكلمة الكاملة، والتحقق من عقد الإطارات قبل الرندر. — A dependency-free ES module that exports 12 deterministic animation primitives you can seek to any time: clamp, easing, keyframe interpolation and timelines, SVG stroke reveal, camera pan/zoom, walk-cycle joint angles, parallax, seeded hand-drawn line jitter, SMPTE-style frame timecode, whole-word caption cue state and a render frame-contract check.
when: أبي دوال جاهزة للـ easing والكي فريم في الأنيميشن بتاعي / Give me deterministic easing/keyframe helpers for a seekable SVG animation
how: import: `import {ease, interpolate, timeline, strokeReveal, camera, walkRig, parallax, seededSketchLine, timeCode, wordCueState, assertFrameContract, clamp} from "./resources/motion-runtime/motion_toolkit.mjs";`; ease: `ease(0.5, "cubic")  // 0.5; kinds: linear | smooth | in | out | cubic`; interpolate: `interpolate(2, 1, 3, 4, 8)  // 6`; timeline: `timeline(2, [{time:0,value:0},{time:1,value:10},{time:3,value:20}])  // 15`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-toolkit`. Limits: Supplies math primitives only: it draws, renders and edits nothing, and has just five easing curves and a single sine-based walk cycle.
params: in: Plain numbers and objects passed as function arguments, such as time in seconds, keyframe arrays [{time, value}], word cues [{word, start, end}], and option objects. · out: New plain values or objects (numbers, {strokeDasharray, strokeDashoffset}, {zoom, x, y}, point arrays, timecode strings). Invalid input throws an Error. No files are written.
section: Motion graphics and rendering / الموشن والرندر

what: يصيّر فيديو B-roll حقيقيًا بحركة كاميرا (تقريب وابتعاد وتحريك جانبي) عبر FFmpeg، انطلاقًا من قائمة EDL جاهزة للإنتاج وبيان لقطات مرخّصة. ينسخ مسار الصوت الأصلي دون أي تعديل، ويتحقق من عدد الإطارات ومن تطابق بصمة الصوت. — Renders a real camera-motion B-roll video master with FFmpeg from a production-ready cinematic_cut_planner EDL and a licensed footage manifest (push-in, pull-back and pan per shot, exact frame counts), stream-copies the original audio and verifies frame count and audio bitstream hash.
when: صيّر لي فيديو B-roll بحركة كاميرا على الصوت الأصلي من غير ما يتغير / Render the EDL into a real video with slow push-ins and keep my audio bit-identical
how: render: `python3 scripts/cinematic_broll_render.py --edl ./edl.json --manifest ./clips.json --audio ./voice.wav --out ./out/master.mkv --width 1080 --height 1920`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool cinematic-broll-render`. Limits: Produces only a camera-motion B-roll master with no captions, Arabic text, graphics, transitions or audio mix, and its rights checks trust the manifest's declared flags.
params: in: --edl: production_ready kosif.edl.v1 JSON from cinematic_cut_planner.py; --manifest: JSON array of clips (same fields as the planner plus sha256 and license_evidence_url or license_document; relative paths resolve against the manifest folder); --audio: the original audio master whose duration matches the EDL within 0.04 s; --out: new .mkv (or .mp4 when the audio codec allows); --width/--height: even values >=32 (default 1080x1920). · out: A video file (H.264 yuv420p, CRF 19) with the original audio stream copied unchanged, plus a JSON report on stdout: path, video_frames, width, height, fps, audio_codec, audio_original_sha256, audio_packet_sha256, audio_bitstream_verified_identical. Temporary shots are deleted.
section: Editing and reference video / المونتاج والفيديو المرجعي

what: يبني قائمة قرارات مونتاج (EDL) حتمية بصيغة JSON من توقيت الكلمات وبيان لقطات مرخّصة ومراجَعة، فيقسّم المشاهد عند وقفات الكلام، ويختار لكل مشهد اللقطة الأنسب بحسب الوسوم، ويحدد حركة الكاميرا، ويسجّل النواقص بدل اختلاق لقطات. — Builds a deterministic JSON edit decision list (kosif.edl.v1) from word timings and a reviewed, licensed footage manifest: splits scenes at speech pauses or every 7 s, picks the best tag-matching clip per scene, assigns camera moves and lists blockers instead of inventing footage.
when: عندي تعليق صوتي وتوقيت كلمات ولقطات مرخصة، اعمل لي خطة مونتاج / Plan which licensed B-roll clip goes under each spoken phrase
how: plan: `python3 scripts/cinematic_cut_planner.py --words ./words.json --clips ./clips.json --duration 48.5 --fps 30 --out ./out/edl.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool cinematic-cut-planner`. Limits: Plans only: it does not inspect footage pixels, transcribe, download or render anything, and matches clips purely by word/tag overlap.
params: in: --words: a bare JSON array of {word|text,start,end,emphasis?} in seconds; --clips: JSON array of clips with id, path, duration, width, height, license_verified, reviewed_frames, contains_text, contains_excluded_people, is_moving_video, and tags/description; --duration: audio seconds; --fps: 24/25/30/60; --out: JSON path. · out: EDL JSON (schema kosif.edl.v1) with video {fps,1080x1920,frame_count}, an audio lock policy, scenes (frames, spoken_text, key_words, footage_id/path, trim, camera move + easing, rights_status), rejected_clips, blockers and production_ready; a one-line JSON summary on stdout.
section: Editing and reference video / المونتاج والفيديو المرجعي

what: يقرأ فيديو محليًا مصرّحًا به عبر ffprobe لاستخراج المدة والأبعاد ومعدل الإطارات ووجود الصوت، ويشغّل اختياريًا كشف تغيّر المشاهد عبر FFmpeg، ثم يخرج تقرير توقيت بصيغة JSON بنقاط القطع المرشّحة والمقاطع، وهو مُدخل تحتاجه أدوات المونتاج اللاحقة. — Reads an authorized local video with ffprobe (duration, size, fps, audio presence) and optionally runs ffmpeg scene-change detection, producing a JSON timing report of cut candidates and segments that downstream KOSIF edit tools require.
when: شوف الفيديو المرجعي ده فيه كام قطع وفين / Detect the cut points in this reference reel
how: metadata: `python3 scripts/motion_reference_probe.py ./in.mp4`; cuts: `python3 scripts/motion_reference_probe.py ./in.mp4 --cuts --threshold 0.35 --out ./cuts.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-reference-probe`. Limits: Cut candidates are heuristic scene-change detections that can miss dissolves or fire on flashes, and it does no object, motion, speech or semantic analysis.
params: in: A local regular (non-symlink) video file of at most 300 s and 1 GB; --cuts to enable detection; --threshold in (0,1), default 0.35; optional --out for a new JSON path whose parent exists. · out: JSON report with status 'reference_timing_observed_not_animation_reconstructed', target, width, height, fps_rational, duration_seconds, audio_present, cut_detection_run, cut_candidates_seconds, segments and limitations, printed to stdout or saved to --out. Errors print {status:failed,error} to stderr with exit 2.
install: needs on PATH: ffprobe · optional: bin:ffmpeg
section: Editing and reference video / المونتاج والفيديو المرجعي

what: يحوّل تقرير القطعات المستخرج من فيديو مرجعي، مع إشارات الصوت والبصمة البصرية والمقاطع المملوكة اختياريًا، إلى مشروع Remotion جديد قابل للتعديل، بلقطات دقيقة على مستوى الإطار وقطعات لا تقسم الكلمات، دون تصييره. — Turns a motion_reference_probe cut report (plus optional audio cues, visual fingerprint and owned replacement clips) into a new, unrendered, editable Remotion React project with frame-exact shots, word-safe cuts and a quality-gate audit.
when: عايز أعمل مونتاج بنفس إيقاع قطعات الفيديو ده بس بلقطاتي أنا / Rebuild this reference video's cut rhythm as an editable Remotion project
how: build-project: `python3 scripts/reference_edit_engine.py --probe ./cuts.json --out ./new-edit`; build-project-with-audio-and-look: `python3 scripts/reference_edit_engine.py --probe ./cuts.json --cues ./cues.json --visual ./reference-look.json --fps 30 --out ./new-edit`; build-project-with-owned-media: `python3 scripts/reference_edit_engine.py --probe ./cuts.json --cues ./cues.json --manifest ./my-assets.json --assets-dir ./my-assets --out ./new-edit`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool reference-edit-engine`. Limits: Generates source code only: it does not install Remotion, render an MP4, understand shot content or reproduce the reference's effects, and output is fixed at 1080x1920.
params: in: --probe: JSON from motion_reference_probe.py --cuts (required); optional --cues: kosif.audio-cues.v1 JSON from audio_cue_mapper.py; --visual: JSON from reference_visual_fingerprint.py of the same video; --manifest {clips:[...],audio:'...'} with --assets-dir of owned .mp4/.mov/.webm/.m4v and .mp3/.wav/.m4a/.aac files; --fps 24/25/30/60; --out: a new directory whose parent exists. · out: A new unrendered Remotion project directory: package.json (remotion ^4, react ^19), src/index.jsx, src/Root.jsx, src/Video.jsx, src/plan.json (schema kosif.reference-edit.v1), decision-report.json (evidence flags), quality-audit.json (creative_quality_gate result), README.md, plus public/assets/ when owned media is given; prints a one-line JSON status.
install: optional: bin:node, npm:@remotion/cli, npm:react, npm:react-dom, npm:remotion
section: Editing and reference video / المونتاج والفيديو المرجعي

what: يفكّ ترميز فيديو محلي مصرّح به بدقة 64×36 وبمعدل إطارين في الثانية عبر FFmpeg، ويقيس لكل لقطة لوحة الألوان والإضاءة والتباين والتشبّع ومقدار التغيّر ومرشّحات الإزاحة التقريبية، ثم يكتب بصمة JSON يستطيع محرك المونتاج المرجعي تحويلها إلى ألوان مشاهد جديدة. — Decodes an authorized local video at 64x36 and 2 fps with ffmpeg and measures per-shot palette, luma, contrast, saturation, frame change and coarse translation candidates, writing a JSON fingerprint that reference_edit_engine can apply as new shot colors.
when: استخرج ألوان وإضاءة كل لقطة من الفيديو المرجعي / Measure the palette and brightness of each shot in this reference video
how: fingerprint-per-shot: `python3 scripts/reference_visual_fingerprint.py ./in.mp4 --probe ./cuts.json --out ./reference-look.json`; fingerprint-whole: `python3 scripts/reference_visual_fingerprint.py ./in.mp4 --out ./reference-look.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool reference-visual-fingerprint`. Limits: Measures coarse low-resolution pixel statistics only (3-bit-quantized palette, uncalibrated luma, sparse translation guesses), not accurate color grading, object or camera tracking, or semantic understanding.
params: in: A local regular (non-symlink) video of at most 120 s; optional --probe JSON from motion_reference_probe.py --cuts of the same video; --out: a new JSON path whose parent exists (never overwritten). · out: JSON (schema kosif.reference-visual-fingerprint.v1) with duration, sample_fps 2, sample_dimensions [64,36], per-sample rows (luma, contrast, saturation_proxy, mean_rgb, change_ratio, translation) and sections (start/end, palette hex list, mean_luma, mean_contrast, possible_translation, motion_candidate_count), exclusions and source_video_unchanged; prints a one-line status.
section: Editing and reference video / المونتاج والفيديو المرجعي

what: ينتج ملفات JSON حتمية وغير إتلافية لمسارين من مسارات المونتاج: خطة مونتاج نصية تحوّل نطاقات الكلمات المختارة إلى مقاطع فيديو محددة بالإطارات، وعلامات مراجعة دقيقة بالإطار مع تايم كود وإحداثيات اختيارية، دون لمس الصوت أو الفيديو. — Generates deterministic, non-destructive JSON for two editor workflows: a text-based paper edit that turns selected word ranges into frame-bounded video-only segments, and frame-accurate review markers with timecodes and optional pixel anchors.
when: عايز أقص الفيديو بالكلام: خلّي الكلمات من 1 لـ 3 ومن 7 لـ 9 / Make a text-based paper edit from words.json
how: paper-edit: `python3 scripts/video_workflow_bridge.py paper-edit templates/ik-wave-words.json --keep "1-3,5" --fps 30 --out ./out/paper-edit.json`; review: `python3 scripts/video_workflow_bridge.py review ./notes.json --duration 60 --fps 30 --width 1080 --height 1920 --out ./out/review-markers.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool video-workflow-bridge`. Limits: Produces cut and review plans only: it never cuts, renders or plays media, and its paper-edit segments must not be applied to an audio master.
params: in: paper-edit: words.json (list or {words:[...]}) with word/start/end seconds, non-overlapping; --keep ranges such as '1-3,7-9'; --fps. review: notes JSON list of {time,comment,x?,y?} with x/y in 0..1; --duration seconds; --fps; --width/--height. · out: A JSON file at --out (parent dirs created): kosif.video-paper-edit.v1 segments with source/output frames, word indices and text, or kosif.frame-review.v1 markers; prints {status,output,schema}.
section: Editing and reference video / المونتاج والفيديو المرجعي

what: يقيس ملف WAV بترميز PCM بعمق 16 بت (حتى 120 ثانية) ويُخرج ملف JSON بصيغة kosif.audio-cues.v1 يضم غلاف طاقة RMS كل 50 ملي ثانية ومرشحات بدايات الأصوات عند ارتفاع الطاقة. ويستورد اختياريًا توقيتات كلمات جاهزة من WhisperX أو KOSIF بعد التحقق من ترتيبها ومداها، دون أن يختلق سرعة إيقاع أو نبضات أو كلمات أو مشاعر. — Measures a 16-bit PCM WAV (up to 120 s) into a kosif.audio-cues.v1 JSON: a 50 ms RMS energy envelope and rising-energy onset candidates. It can also import existing WhisperX/KOSIF word timings after checking their order and range. It never invents BPM, beats, words or emotion.
when: حلّل الصوت ده وطلّع لي لحظات ارتفاع الطاقة عشان أركّب عليها القطعات / Measure onsets and energy in my voiceover WAV for motion sync
how: measure: `python3 scripts/audio_cue_mapper.py ./voice.wav --out ./out/cues.json`; measure-with-words: `python3 scripts/audio_cue_mapper.py ./voice.wav --aligned-words ./words.json --out ./out/cues.json`; help: `python3 scripts/audio_cue_mapper.py --help`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool audio-cue-mapper`. Limits: Detects amplitude jumps only. It does not estimate tempo or beats, does not transcribe, and does not read MP3/AAC or 24/32-bit WAV, which must first be converted to 16-bit PCM WAV.
params: in: An uncompressed 16-bit PCM WAV, mono or stereo, 8–192 kHz, 0.1–120 s, under 64 MB. Optionally a JSON with words[] or segments[].words[], each {word|text, start, end} in seconds, in order and inside the audio (at most 1500 words). · out: A new JSON file (it refuses to overwrite, and the parent folder must exist) with schema kosif.audio-cues.v1: source, duration, sample_rate, channels, window_seconds, energy_rms[], energy_median, onset_candidates_seconds[], words[{text, start, end}], word_alignment_source, bpm:null, emotion:null, verified_beats:false. A one-line JSON summary is printed on stdout.
install: needs on PATH: python3 · optional: bin:ffmpeg, pip:whisperx
section: Audio and rhythm / الصوت والإيقاع

what: يحوّل ملف kosif.audio-cues.v1 إلى فرضيات لسرعة الإيقاع: يقيّم السرعات من 60 إلى 200 نبضة في الدقيقة مقابل بدايات الأصوات المقيسة، ويعيد أفضل ثلاث سرعات متمايزة. ويضيف شبكة نبضات تقديرية عندما يبلغ أفضل تطابق 0.60 أو أكثر، وأقسام طاقة لكل ثانية مقارنةً بوسيط المقطع. وتُوسم كل النتائج بأنها غير مؤكدة. — Turns a kosif.audio-cues.v1 file into tempo hypotheses. It scores 60–200 BPM against the measured onset candidates and returns the top three distinct tempos. It adds an estimated beat grid when the best match is at least 0.60, plus per-second energy sections relative to the track median. All results are flagged as unverified.
when: طلّع لي البي بي إم التقريبي للمزيكا دي / Estimate the tempo and a beat grid from my measured audio cues
how: estimate: `python3 scripts/music_rhythm_engine.py ./out/cues.json --out ./out/rhythm.json`; help: `python3 scripts/music_rhythm_engine.py --help`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool music-rhythm-engine`. Limits: Gives a heuristic tempo guess from onset alignment only. Half- and double-time errors are common, fewer than 4 onsets gives no tempo, and it detects no chords, mood or lyrics.
params: in: A cues JSON from audio_cue_mapper.py (schema kosif.audio-cues.v1, at most 2 MB, not a symlink): duration up to 120 s, strictly increasing onset_candidates_seconds (at most 600), energy_rms values in 0..1, and window_seconds. · out: A new JSON file (it refuses to overwrite, and the parent folder must exist) with schema kosif.music-rhythm-hypotheses.v1: tempo_hypotheses[up to 3 {bpm, match, aligned_onsets, mean_error_seconds, phase_anchor_seconds}], candidate_tempo_bpm or null, estimated_grid_seconds[], measured_transients_seconds[], relative_energy_sections[{start, end, mean_rms, energy_label}], verified_bpm:false, lyric_understanding:false, emotion_detection:false and notes. A summary JSON is printed on stdout.
section: Audio and rhythm / الصوت والإيقاع

what: يرسم شخصية ثنائية الأبعاد كاملة الجسم بطبقات تمشي وتركض وتلوّح وتبتسم وترمش وتومئ وفق توقيتات زمنية أو كلمات، مستخدمًا حركية عكسية ذات عظمتين للساقين والذراعين. يصدّر صورًا ثابتة PNG أو SVG، أو GIF وMP4 بترميز H.264، مع إمكانية إرفاق الصوت الأصلي بصيغة AAC والتحقق من حزمه. — Renders a layered 2D full-body character that walks, runs, waves, smiles, blinks and nods on time or word cues, using two-bone IK for legs and arms. Exports PNG/SVG stills or GIF/H.264 MP4, with optional packet-verified original AAC audio.
when: خلّي الشخصية تمشي وتلوّح وتبتسم على كلمات التعليق / Animate a 2D character that walks, waves, smiles, blinks and nods
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/character_fullbody.py doctor`; render-still: `python3 scripts/character_fullbody.py render --scene templates/fullbody-demo.json --words templates/fullbody-demo-words.json --time 1.55 --output ./still.png`; render-gif: `python3 scripts/character_fullbody.py render --scene templates/fullbody-demo.json --words templates/fullbody-demo-words.json --fps 8 --output ./walk.gif`; render-mp4-audio: `python3 scripts/character_fullbody.py render --scene templates/fullbody-demo.json --words templates/fullbody-demo-words.json --fps 24 --audio ./voice.m4a --output ./fullbody.mp4`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool character-fullbody`. Limits: One stylized 2D figure with six preset actions and simple leg/arm IK. No 3D, mocap, lip sync, transcription, multiple characters or custom artwork.
params: in: A kosif.fullbody.v1 scene JSON with: a 128-1280 px canvas; duration up to 30 s; character origin, scale 0.35-1.8 and colours; at most 100 actions (walk, run, wave, smile, blink, nod). Actions must be ordered by start, and each has exactly one of time or word (+occurrence), a duration and an optional speed. No two actions may overlap on the same channel. Optional --words JSON {words:[{word,start,end}]} from real alignment. Optional --audio must be AAC (MP4 only) with a length matching the duration. --fps 1-60; --time applies to stills. · out: A new PNG or SVG still, or a GIF or H.264 MP4 (whole frame count, at most 600 frames). Images have five layers: ground, back limbs, torso and head, facial expression, front arm. The MP4 can include the original AAC by stream copy. stdout gets JSON with verified, the output path, frames, sha256, audio_packets_preserved and the format.
install: pip install Pillow · optional: bin:ffmpeg, bin:ffprobe
section: Drawing and characters / الرسم والشخصيات

what: يحرّك ذراع شخصية مرسومة بسيطة بالحركية العكسية التحليلية ذات العظمتين نحو أهداف محددة بالزمن أو بتوقيتات كلمات موثّقة. يصدّر صورًا ثابتة PNG أو SVG، أو GIF وMP4 بترميز H.264، مع إمكانية نسخ التعليق الصوتي الأصلي بصيغة AAC دون إعادة ترميز والتحقق منه ببصمات الحزم. — Animates a simple drawn character's arm with analytic two-bone inverse kinematics toward targets cued by time or by verified word timestamps. Exports PNG/SVG stills or GIF/H.264 MP4, optionally with the original AAC narration stream-copied and verified by packet hashes.
when: حرّك ذراع الشخصية لما يقول كلمة ارفع / Make the character raise its arm on a specific word from my narration
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/character_ik.py doctor`; render-still: `python3 scripts/character_ik.py render --scene templates/ik-wave-demo.json --words templates/ik-wave-words.json --time 0.8 --output ./pose.png`; render-video: `python3 scripts/character_ik.py render --scene templates/ik-wave-demo.json --words templates/ik-wave-words.json --fps 24 --output ./wave.mp4`; render-with-audio: `python3 scripts/character_ik.py render --scene templates/ik-wave-demo.json --words templates/ik-wave-words.json --fps 24 --audio ./narration.m4a --output ./wave-voice.mp4`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool character-ik`. Limits: Animates one two-bone arm on an otherwise static simple figure. It is not full-body rigging, lip sync, transcription or AI character generation.
params: in: A kosif.ik.v1 scene JSON with: a 128-2048 px canvas; duration up to 30 s; a rig (shoulder, upper/lower bone lengths, bend ±1, colours, widths); 1-100 targets, each with exactly one of time or word (+occurrence), a point and travel. The first target must sit at time 0 with travel 0. Optional --words JSON ({words:[{word,start,end}]} sorted by start, from real alignment). Optional --audio must be AAC and match the scene length. --fps 1-60; --time applies to stills only. · out: A new PNG or SVG still at --time, or a GIF or H.264 MP4 of the whole scene. duration×fps must be a whole number of frames, at most 600. The MP4 can carry the original AAC by stream copy. stdout gets JSON with the output path, sha256, frames, fps, cue_times and audio_packet_copy_verified.
install: pip install Pillow · optional: bin:ffmpeg, bin:ffprobe
section: Drawing and characters / الرسم والشخصيات

what: يولّد ستوري بورد قابلًا للتحرير بصيغة JSON لمحرّك الحركة بمقاس 1080×1920، مع ملف HTML مستقل اختياري يمكن التنقّل فيه زمنيًا. يعرض الستوري بورد شخصيات بشرية أو قططًا مرسومة متجهيًا تظهر بأسلوب الرسم التدريجي في شارع أو حديقة، بست حركات وثلاثة تعابير وتوقيتات كلمات حقيقية اختيارية. — Generates an editable 1080x1920 Motion Director storyboard JSON, plus an optional self-contained seekable HTML preview. The storyboard shows procedural vector human and/or cat characters drawing on in a street or park, with six actions, three moods and optional real word timestamps.
when: ارسم لي شخص وقطة يمشون في شارع كموشن جرافيك / Draw a hand-drawn style character walking down a street as an editable animation
how: generate: `python3 scripts/code_drawing_master.py --cast human+cat --expression happy --location street --action walk --out ./story.json --html ./story.html`; generate-with-words: `python3 scripts/code_drawing_master.py --cast human --action wave --duration 9 --words-json ./words.json --out ./talk.json --html ./talk.html`; generate-json-only: `python3 scripts/code_drawing_master.py --cast cat --expression determined --location park --action run --duration 12 --fps 30 --out ./cat-park.json`; help: `python3 scripts/code_drawing_master.py --help`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool code-drawing-master`. Limits: Produces a fixed, stylized procedural storyboard (two locations, preset human/cat rigs, six actions) and only compiles HTML. It does not render MP4, transcribe speech, lip-sync or accept custom artwork.
params: in: CLI choices only: --cast human|cat|human+cat (default human+cat); --expression happy|sad|determined; --location street|park; --action idle|walk|run|wave|point|sit; --duration 4-120 s (default 9); --fps 24|25|30|60. Optional --words-json takes pre-aligned timestamps (words[] or WhisperX segments[].words, at most 240 words). They must be non-overlapping and inside the duration. --out and --html must be new paths in existing directories. · out: A new Motion Director v1 storyboard JSON at --out. It holds one 1080x1920 scene with draw-on street or park paths, a title, a polygon morph, articulated actors (20-part human, 14-part cat) with post-draw movement, a camera zoom and the words. Optional --html adds a self-contained seekable HTML that embeds assets/motion_engine.js. A JSON report goes to stdout with rendered:false.
section: Drawing and characters / الرسم والشخصيات

what: يرسم مشهدًا بطبقات معرّفًا بصيغة JSON صارمة (مستطيلات وأشكال بيضاوية وخطوط ومضلعات وضربات فرشاة حساسة للضغط ونصوص) باستخدام Pillow ويصدّره صورًا ثابتة PNG أو SVG، أو يحرّك الطبقات كاملة بإطارات مفتاحية ويصدّرها GIF أو MP4 بترميز H.264. — Paints a strict JSON layered scene (rectangles, ellipses, lines, polygons, pressure brush strokes, text) with Pillow into PNG/SVG stills, or animates whole layers with keyframes into GIF or H.264 MP4.
when: ارسم لوحة بطبقات وصدّرها PNG وSVG / Paint a layered illustration from JSON and export PNG and SVG
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/creative_paint.py doctor`; render: `python3 scripts/creative_paint.py render --scene templates/creative-paint-demo.json --output ./paint.png --time 0.5`; render-svg: `python3 scripts/creative_paint.py render --scene templates/creative-paint-demo.json --output ./paint.svg`; animate-gif: `python3 scripts/creative_paint.py animate --scene templates/creative-paint-demo.json --output ./paint.gif --fps 12 --duration 2`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool creative-paint`. Limits: A simple 2D primitive painter with whole-layer keyframes only: no AI generation, per-shape animation or PSD. In SVG, brush pressure becomes a plain polyline and blend modes are dropped.
params: in: A kosif.paint.v1 JSON scene with: integer width/height up to 2048; background as #RRGGBB[AA] or 'transparent'; 1-150 layers (name, opacity, blend normal|multiply|screen, visible); at most 1500 shapes in total. Shape kinds are rectangle, ellipse, line, polygon, brush ([x,y,pressure] points) and text (optional font file path). Optional per-layer keyframes set x/y/angle/scale/opacity with linear or ease-in-out. render takes --time in seconds; animate takes --fps 1-60 and --duration up to 30 s. · out: render writes a new .png or .svg. animate writes a new .gif, or a .mp4 (H.264, CRF 18) via ffmpeg. stdout gets JSON with the output path, sha256, bytes or frames, and a verified flag. Existing outputs are never overwritten.
section: Drawing and characters / الرسم والشخصيات

what: يحوّل ضربات الرسم الحر المعرّفة بصيغة JSON إلى رسمة بطبقات، ويطابق كل ضربة اختياريًا مع مستطيل أو شكل بيضاوي أو خط مستقيم بهندسة حتمية، ثم يعرض الأشكال المتعرَّف عليها أو يصدّر الرسمة PNG أو SVG. — Turns freehand stroke JSON into a layered drawing, optionally snapping each stroke to a rectangle, ellipse or straight line with deterministic geometry. It then reports the recognized shapes or renders the drawing to PNG/SVG.
when: حوّل خربشاتي إلى مستطيل ودائرة وخط مستقيم / Snap my rough freehand strokes into clean shapes
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/smart_draw.py doctor`; analyze: `python3 scripts/smart_draw.py analyze --scene templates/smart-draw-demo.json`; render-svg: `python3 scripts/smart_draw.py render --scene templates/smart-draw-demo.json --output ./sketch.svg`; render-png: `python3 scripts/smart_draw.py render --scene templates/smart-draw-demo.json --output ./sketch.png`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool smart-draw`. Limits: Heuristic geometric snapping into four classes only (rectangle, ellipse, line, freehand). No ML object recognition like AutoDraw, no eraser, collaboration or template library.
params: in: A kosif.smartdraw.v1 JSON with: integer width/height 128-2048; background; 1-100 strokes, each with 2-1500 [x,y,pressure?] points inside the canvas, a color (#RRGGBB), width 1-80, brush pen|marker|highlighter and assist true/false. Only strokes with assist:true are classified. · out: analyze prints JSON {recognized:[{stroke,recognized,brush}],layers} to stdout. render also writes a new .png or .svg, one layer per stroke, and adds the output path and byte count. Existing files are never overwritten.
section: Drawing and characters / الرسم والشخصيات

what: يجري جردًا ثابتًا للقراءة فقط لمجلد محلي ويعرضه في تقرير JSON دون تشغيل أي شيء. يشمل التقرير أعداد الملفات وامتداداتها وتوجيهها (مراجعة الشيفرة، والملفات الثنائية المرشحة للتحليل بـ Ghidra أو REA، والأرشيفات، والوسائط) والمؤشرات النمطية وبصمات SHA-256 وإحصاءات أمان ملفات zip. — Performs a read-only static inventory of a local folder and returns it as a JSON report, without executing anything. The report covers file counts, extensions, routing (source review, Ghidra/REA binary candidates, archives, media), regex indicators, SHA-256 hashes and zip safety stats.
when: افحص مجلد المشروع هذا وقل لي محتواه بدون تشغيل أي شيء / Do a read-only triage of this local project folder
how: scan: `python3 scripts/local_project_audit.py ./my-project`; scan-with-report: `python3 scripts/local_project_audit.py ./my-project --output ./audit/report.json --limit 20000`; help: `python3 scripts/local_project_audit.py --help`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool local-project-audit`. Limits: Static, file-level triage by extension and regex signatures only. It never executes or extracts anything and cannot prove runtime behavior, malware status or licensing.
params: in: A local directory path (positional root). Optional --output gives a report path outside that directory; optional --limit sets the maximum number of files, 1-1,000,000 (default 100000). · out: A one-line JSON summary on stdout (schema kosif.local-project-audit.v1, without samples or skipped items). With --output, the full report also includes up to 120 sample records (path, bytes, route, sha256 for files up to 4 MB, indicators, zip entries/uncompressed bytes/ratio/unsafe_path_count) and up to 30 skipped entries.
section: Software investigation / فحص البرامج

what: يدقق تدقيقًا ساكنًا كل سجل قدرة في data/powers/*.json بحثًا عن المعرّفات المكررة والسجلات المعطوبة وتغطية روابط الإثبات، ويكتفي بالتحقق من وجود المراجع المحلية 'kosif-tool/...'، ويحصي الحالات ونطاقات الإثبات المعلنة. — Statically audits every power record in data/powers/*.json for duplicate ids, malformed records and proof-link coverage, checks only whether local 'kosif-tool/...' references exist, and counts claimed statuses and proof scopes.
when: افحص كتالوج القدرات وشوف فيه سجلات مكررة أو روابط إثبات ناقصة / audit the powers catalog for duplicate ids and broken proof links
how: audit: `python3 scripts/catalog_evidence_audit.py`; --skill: `python3 scripts/catalog_evidence_audit.py --skill .`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool catalog-evidence-audit`. Limits: Checks only that local reference paths exist, never runs a capability, and leaves every URL, sibling-repo or archive reference unverified, so a clean report does not prove that anything works.
params: in: Optional --skill path to a skill folder that contains data/powers/*.json (defaults to this skill). · out: JSON report on stdout. Exit 0 when there are no record integrity errors, 1 otherwise (a missing local reference does not change the exit code).
section: Maintain and build / الصيانة والبناء
